title: All Possible Full Binary Trees
description: Given an integer n, return a list of all possible full binary trees with n nodes.

steps.note: Looping through possible left subtree sizes i=1
Recursively get left subtree for i=1
Recursively get right subtree for n-1-i = 1
Combine left and right to form a full binary tree with 3 nodes
Return list of full binary trees
